stem: Fresh transplants occupy only a small portion of a much larger container, and large irrigation events keep the unrooted lower media wet for long periods. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: The crop needs stronger fertilizer because roots are small
The container should be kept fully saturated until roots reach the bottom
Irrigation should be matched to current root occupancy, media behavior, and measured depletion rather than the mature-container schedule
The only useful measurement is canopy height
rationale: Young root systems may not use water throughout the full container volume. Irrigation should reflect current root occupancy and measured root-zone behavior rather than assuming mature demand immediately after transplant.
